components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal yellow action button with asphalt border.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 4px; border: 2px solid #18202b; background: #f2b705; color: #18202b; padding: 14px 24px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0a900; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b4ea2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 4px; border: 2px solid #18202b; background: transparent; color: #18202b; padding: 14px 24px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b4ea2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product Frame
components.description: Structured white dossier frame with asphalt border.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid #18202b; background: #ffffff; color: #18202b; padding: 24px; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #4a5461; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: High-contrast form input with Sign Blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid #18202b; background: #ffffff; color: #18202b; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b4ea2; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: EuroPermis adopts the clarity and quiet authority of European road signage and official public-service stationery. Surfaces sit on warm chalk paper and crisp white sheets, anchored by deep asphalt ink, with signal yellow reserved strictly for primary actions and progress.
keyCharacteristics: Warm chalk canvas with high-contrast asphalt ink and crisp structural rules
Signal yellow reserved exclusively for primary actions and progress
Condensed display headings paired with humanist sans and tabular mono with Romanian diacritics
Real Romanian road sign photography with explicit public attribution

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow appears only on primary actions, active progress indicators, and focus highlights.

rules.name: The Asphalt Text Rule
rules.body: Never place white or light text on Signal Yellow; always pair with Asphalt Ink.

rules.name: The Proper Diacritic Rule
rules.body: Always use Romanian comma-below characters (ș, ț) via latin-ext.

dos: Do keep Signal Yellow (#f2b705) strictly under 10% of any viewport and always pair it with Asphalt Ink (#18202b) text.
Do use real Romanian road photographs from credits.json with proper alt text in Romanian.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on all Framer Motion transitions.
Do enforce 44px minimum touch targets on mobile for exam answers and controls.
donts: Don't use purple gradients, neon accents, or gratuitous glassmorphism blur cards.
Don't use emojis or Unicode symbols as UI icons.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headings or decorative section numbers.
Don't replace real road sign photographs with simplified vector drawings or AI imagery.
Don't ever label the platform document permis or permis de conducere.
